title.zh: 基于 NLI 的有据性检查

prompt.zh: 用一个自然语言推理模型判断一个句子是否被一段资料所支持，并把它扩展为对整段回答的有据性评分。测试用例中包含 7.2 的 mini-RAG 实际给出的三个错误回答。
prompt.en: Use a natural language inference model to decide whether a sentence is supported by a piece of material, and extend this to a groundedness score for a whole answer. The test cases include the three wrong answers that the mini-RAG of 7.2 actually gave.

hints.zh: 类别的顺序因模型而异。用 `{v.lower(): k for k, v in model.config.id2label.items()}['entailment']` 找到蕴含对应的下标。
hints.en: The order of the classes differs between models. Find the index of entailment with `{v.lower(): k for k, v in model.config.id2label.items()}['entailment']`.

hints.zh: 整段回答的得分是各句得分的最小值，每一句的得分是它在各段落下蕴含概率的最大值。
hints.en: The score of the whole answer is the minimum of the sentence scores, and the score of a sentence is the maximum of its entailment probabilities over the passages.
